discovery.auth: RecipeID (public key) on every URL + PartnerBillingKey (secret) for order submission; keys in account settings

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the auditor.
auth: 1. Create a Gooten account; API keys in account settings

endpoints.purpose: catalogue, SKUs, options, image templates; create / update / delete print-ready products

endpoints.call: Price Estimate · Shipping Options · Address Validation
Orders: submit, search, get by id, update status / shipping / SKU / artwork, cancel item

reference.limits: Not published. - PartnerBillingKey charges the partner account - HTTPS only

fields.name: recipe_id
fields.help: Gooten RecipeID (public key, Admin Panel > Settings > API), sent as the `recipeid` query parameter on every call.

fields.name: partner_billing_key
fields.help: Gooten PartnerBillingKey (private key from the same API settings page), sent inside create_order's Payment object so Gooten bills your account; required only for create_order.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists the supported shipping countries ({Countries[{Name, Code, IsSupported, DefaultCurrency}]}) for the RecipeID.

list_products.note: Your Print Ready Products (products already combined with your artwork): {PageCount, Page, Products[{ProductName, NumberOfVariants}]}. `query`, `category` and `limit` are not accepted (Gooten sets the page size). Gooten's base catalogue is a static CDN file (productdatav3/catalog.json), not an API call.

create_order.note: Submits a LIVE order billed to your Gooten account through the PartnerBillingKey (IsInTestMode is not sent). `shipping_address` is Gooten's address {FirstName, LastName, Line1, Line2, City, State, CountryCode, PostalCode, Phone, Email} and is also used as BillingAddress; `items` are Gooten items [{SKU, Quantity, ShipType (standard|expedited|overnight), Images[{Url}]}] - the shipping method is per item, so `shipping_option` is not sent. Answers {Id} (the order id get_order takes); validation failures come back as HadError=true with Errors[{PropertyName, ErrorMessage}].

get_order.note: GET orders/?id= : {Id, NiceId, SourceId, Items[{Sku, Quantity, Status, TrackingNumber, TrackingUrl, ShipCarrierName, Price{Price, CurrencyCode}, Shipments[]}], ShipToAddress, ...}. Gooten tracks status per item; `status`/`tracking_number` are the first item's. Order totals are per item (Items[].Price) and not mapped to `total`.

track.note: One row per order item with its status, carrier and tracking number/URL (Items[].Shipments holds split shipments, in `raw`).

not_offered.get_product: Product variants (GET productvariants/?productId=&countryCode=) return ProductVariants[{Sku, Options, PriceInfo}] without a product title or id record, and the catalogue itself is a static CDN file (productdatav3/catalog.json), so there is no single-product read to map.
not_offered.quote_shipping: GET shippriceestimate/?productId=&countryCode=&currencyCode= answers one {MinPrice, MaxPrice, EstShipDays, CanShipExpedited} estimate rather than a list of shipping options, and currencyCode is required; POST shippingprices needs a full cart (ShipToCountry, Items[{SKU, Quantity}]).

evidence: host api.print.io: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
